description: The file defines the ListLayoutMetaDataParser class, responsible for parsing and managing list view layout metadata within the SuiteCRM framework. It includes methods for retrieving default, additional, and available fields, handling layout deployment, and managing view definitions.

classes.name: ListLayoutMetaDataParser
classes.description: A parser class for handling list view layout metadata in SuiteCRM, supporting layout retrieval, deployment, and field management.

methods.name: getArrayDiff
methods.description: Returns array elements from the first array that are not present in the second array.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Deploys the current layout, optionally updating it from the request.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Returns the current view definitions layout array.

methods.name: getDefaultFields
methods.description: Returns a list of default fields for the list view.

methods.name: getAdditionalFields
methods.description: Returns additional available fields for user creation.

methods.name: getAvailableFields
methods.description: Returns fields that are available for use in the list view but not currently selected.

methods.name: isValidField
methods.description: Checks if a field is valid for display in the list view based on its properties.

methods.name: _populateFromRequest
methods.description: Updates the view definitions based on submitted request data, enabling layout customization.

methods.name: getOriginalTemplateDefinitions
methods.description: Returns the original template definitions for the view layout.

methods.name: createViewDefsByFieldDefs
methods.description: Creates view definitions from field definitions, applying specific rules and modifications.

methods.name: removeField
methods.description: Removes a specified field from the layout definitions.

methods.name: getOriginalViewDefs
methods.description: Returns the original view definitions, keyed by lowercase field names.

methods.name: _trimFieldDefs
methods.description: Simplifies and filters a field definition array to essential properties.
